info.title: ClientLedger Trial Balance engine
info.description: Desktop-mode API of the Vibe Trial Balance engine. Every response uses the { data, error, meta } envelope. Amounts are integer cents.

start_date.description: DATE column, serialized as UTC midnight

end_date.description: DATE column, serialized as UTC midnight

ChartAccount.description: One account on a client chart of accounts (the import picks accounts from these, Q37).

tax_line_source.description: Who chose the tax code: manual, ai, import, rule, cross_client, firm_history

tax_line_confidence.description: How sure the AI was, 0 to 1 (a decimal column: "0.62")

cash_flow_category.description: Where the statement of cash flows puts the account (Q62)

TrialBalanceRow.description: One account on the adjusted trial balance (view v_adjusted_trial_balance). Each stage is a debit/credit pair in cents.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the whole file, hex

idMappings.description: Per table, archive id -> restored id

fileName.description: A desktop full backup in BACKUPS_DIR

clientId.description: The client id inside that backup

outName.description: The client .tbak to write in BACKUPS_DIR

TbTotals.description: Column totals of GET /periods/{periodId}/trial-balance, summed by PostgreSQL over the same rows.

ClientSummary.description: One period of an active client, as the Clients screen shows it (Q16).

last_worked.description: Newest change to the trial balance, an entry or a task

expectedUpdatedAt.description: row_updated_at as read; 409 STALE_WRITE when the row changed since

JournalEntryLineInput.description: One line: a debit or a credit, never both, never zero

isRecurring.description: Copied into the next period at roll-forward

JournalEntryUpdate.description: Header fields and, when given, all lines (replaced in one transaction). Changing entryType keeps the entry number, which can collide with an entry of the other type (the desktop does not offer it).

JournalEntryCreated.description: The new entry; its lines echo the request (no account number or name)

CsvColumnMapping.description: A mapping the user chose (lib/csvColumnMapping.ts); replaces the guess.

csvRow.description: Line index in the file, from 0

fallbackMode.description: The columns were guessed without AI

AccountUpdate.description: Fields to change on an account (only those sent). W/P ref, notes and lead sheet belong to the account, so they show in every period. An empty string clears a text field.

leadSheetId.description: One of the client's lead sheets; null clears it

taxCodeId.description: A tax code; null clears it. The source and confidence stay as they were unless taxLineSource is sent (the desktop assigns through /tax-lines/bulk-confirm, which sets both).

cashFlowCategory.description: Where the statement of cash flows puts the account; null clears it. The appliance offers non_cash for revenue and expense accounts only, the others for balance sheet accounts (Q62).

FirmIdentity.description: Name, address and email of the firm (engine settings firm_name, firm_address, firm_email). The name prints as "Prepared by" on every report PDF (Q62).

Tickmark.description: One mark in a client's tickmark library

AccountTickmarks.description: Marks on each account for a period, keyed by account id

BankTransaction.description: One bank transaction. amount is cents, positive = money into the bank account. A row is posted (an entry_type trans journal entry) when it has an account, a source account and a period.

amount.description: cents (a string in the PATCH answer: the row as written)

BankTransactionUpdate.description: Only the fields sent change. A null accountId or periodId unposts the row.

BankRowsImport.description: Bank rows parsed by the desktop (OFX, QFX, QIF, CSV) or read from a PDF statement. Duplicates are keyed as the engine's own file import keys them (date, description, amount, check number, source account, occurrence in this request). Rows with no date, no description or a zero amount are left out and not counted.

BankStatementAnalysis.description: What the AI read from a bank statement PDF; nothing is written. Amounts are cents, positive = money in. Opening and closing balances are as the AI wrote them (cents, not rounded) and may be missing.

date.description: As the AI wrote it (asked for YYYY-MM-DD)

visionMode.description: The pages were read as images

transactions.description: The account's bank rows dated on or before the statement date, less those cleared in an earlier completed reconciliation

visionMode.description: The pages were read as images (a scanned PDF)

LlmProvider.description: AI settings. The desktop uses provider claude (key from the OS keychain, handed to the engine as ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, never stored here), ollama, or openai-compat (a local server with no key, or DigitalOcean serverless inference at https://inference.do-ai.run with a model access key in openaiCompatApiKey). On a PUT only the fields sent change; a PUT without provider leaves the provider in use as it is and is not checked for a model.

openaiCompatApiKey.description: GET: masked (dots and the last four characters) or empty. PUT: the key; an empty string removes it. Kept encrypted in the settings table (so in the database and full backups).

LeadSheetSuggestion.description: A lead sheet the engine proposes for one account (auto-assign preview); writes nothing.

suggestedLeadSheetId.description: The client's lead sheet the rule names; null when none matched or the client has no sheet with that code

changed.description: The suggestion differs from the current lead sheet

TaxCodeMap.description: What one tax program calls a tax code, and the account a combined export row gets.

is_system.description: Shipped with the program (false: added by the firm)

software_code.description: Present when a tax program was asked for

maps.description: Present on one code read, created or saved

TaxCodeInput.description: A tax code as saved. PUT replaces the whole row: a field left out goes back to its default (isSystem false, isActive true, sortOrder 0, notes empty), so the desktop sends every field. notes is a string or left out, never null. maps names the tax programs to save; a program left out keeps its row, and a field left out of a named program is cleared.

TaxCodeImportRow.description: One line of a tax code CSV as read; nothing is checked against the codes already there.

reasoning.description: Starts "AI error:" when the AI could not be asked (none set up, or it failed)

TaxSuggestions.description: Suggested tax codes. Nothing is written: the caller confirms through bulk-confirm.

bySource.description: Left out when no account was looked at

taxCodeId.description: null clears the account's tax code

ExportValidation.description: What to look at before exporting. Advisory: the export routes never refuse.

isBalanced.description: Unadjusted, book-adjusted and tax-adjusted all balance

totalBookAmt.description: Book-adjusted total (dollars, debits positive; not cents)

totalTaxAmt.description: Tax-adjusted total (dollars, debits positive; not cents)

ExportConsolidation.description: The tax codes whose accounts are combined into one export row, by tax code id, for one client and tax program. The export routes do not read this: the caller sends consolidate and overrides with each download.

indent.description: Extra indent levels on top of the tree depth

sizeDelta.description: Points added to the element style

accountId.description: A database id as a decimal string; -1 is the virtual retained-earnings account

hideWhenZero.description: Hide when every rounded amount column is zero; unset follows the style

breakBefore.description: Start a new page before this line

hideWhenZero.description: Hide when every rounded amount column is zero; unset follows the style

breakBefore.description: Start a new page before this line

groupingId.description: A database id as a decimal string; -1 is the virtual retained-earnings account

ref.description: One of the client's lead sheets (groupingId), or a code to bind (templates)

FsNode.description: A line of a statement. Ids are unique within a statement.

pageSetup.description: Overrides the style's page for this statement

plugs.description: Rounding plug: anchor node id to the line that takes the difference

FsLayout.description: A statement layout. A client layout names the client's lead sheets and accounts; a firm template names lead sheet codes only.

framework.description: gaap and cash read book balances (cash changes the wording); tax reads tax-adjusted balances

entityKind.description: Overrides the kind implied by the client's return type

letterId.description: A library letter; null: the default one

bodyHtmlOverride.description: This report's own wording (sanitized HTML with {{variables}}); null: the library letter's

resolutions.description: Unbound template line (node id) to one of the client's lead sheets, or null to remove the line; a line not named stays unlinked

expectedUpdatedAt.description: updatedAt as read. When it no longer matches, the save is refused (409 FS_CONFLICT). The desktop always sends it.

FsDraftOverrides.description: Unsaved changes to compute or print instead of the saved ones

reason.description: At least 5 characters when overriding failed checks

message.description: The engine's words (server wording; the desktop says its own)

updatedAt.description: Send back as expectedUpdatedAt, as read

FsClientLayout.description: A client layout: shared by every statement set of the client that uses it

stale.description: Something the statements are built from changed since they were issued

regenerated.description: The PDF was drawn again from the issued snapshot (after a restore)

values.description: One per column: amounts rounded for display (dollars, or cents with 2 decimals), percents as 12.3

FsRenderedReport.description: What the engine computed: every figure and check. The desktop shows it; it never computes one.

periodUnlocked.description: The period is not locked; its balances can still change

logoDataUri.description: A PNG or JPEG of about 700 KB at most

FsLetterInput.description: All of name, letterType and bodyHtml to create; any of them to change

FsStylePresetInput.description: name and style to create; any of them to change

FsLibrary.description: The firm library (seeded on first read)

FsBindPreview.description: Template lines no lead sheet of the client matches, and the client's lead sheets to choose from

fallbackSource.description: Where the class without an override comes from

FsCashFlowClassification.description: Balance sheet accounts and lead sheets with their Statement Writer cash flow class

items.description: Exactly one of accountId and groupingId

isFold.description: Net income is closed into this account

accountId.description: A database id as a decimal string; -1 is the virtual retained-earnings account

role.description: null: back to the default by name

FsEquityRolesInput.description: At most one account receives net income

displayName.description: Shown on sign-offs, notes and completed tasks

Document.description: A stored file of the client (the list adds the linked account and entry and the uploader)

OpenTask.description: A task not completed or n/a, of any client

signoffs.description: The live signature for each role, when there is one

preparer.description: stale: signed, but the balances moved since

reviewer.description: stale: signed, but the balances moved since

LeadSheetForPeriod.description: A lead sheet with its sign-off status for one period (?periodId=)

trans_adj_debit.description: Transaction adjustments debit (cents, as decimal text)

trans_adj_credit.description: Transaction adjustments credit (cents, as decimal text)

post_trans_debit.description: After transaction adjustments, debit (cents, as decimal text)

post_trans_credit.description: After transaction adjustments, credit (cents, as decimal text)

book_adj_debit.description: Book AJE debit (cents, as decimal text)

book_adj_credit.description: Book AJE credit (cents, as decimal text)

tax_adj_debit.description: Tax AJE debit (cents, as decimal text)

tax_adj_credit.description: Tax AJE credit (cents, as decimal text)

book_adjusted_debit.description: Book adjusted debit (cents, as decimal text)

book_adjusted_credit.description: Book adjusted credit (cents, as decimal text)

tax_adjusted_debit.description: Tax basis debit (cents, as decimal text)

tax_adjusted_credit.description: Tax basis credit (cents, as decimal text)

LeadSheetAccountRow.description: One account of a lead sheet for the period: the trial balance row plus its marks, attachments and notes

currentStamp.description: SHA-256 of the sheet's balances; a signature with another stamp is stale

signoffs.description: The live signature for each role, when there is one

preparer.description: stale: signed, but the balances moved since

reviewer.description: stale: signed, but the balances moved since

notes.description: Every note of the sheet, the account notes too

ref_code.description: The sheet code's letters and a number (A001), never reused

category.description: A short heading the AI chose, such as Balance Check or Prior Year Variance

Observation.description: One thing the AI noticed about the period. Advice only: it changes nothing.

conversationId.description: Carry on this conversation; leave out to start a new one

ChatEvent.description: One server-sent event of a chat answer, sent as `data: <json>` followed by a blank line. In order: start, then delta as the answer is written, then done; or error at any point (the stream then ends). Nothing is kept until done.

message_count.description: How many messages (text from some drivers)

schemaVersion.description: The newest migration (a firm server must be on the same one)

checkoutId.description: The firm server check-out it goes back under

stampAtPull.description: The period stamp in the firm server's pull result

mode.description: new: the client was not here (restored as new, its uids kept); merged: the period put into the client here

stamp.description: The period's stamp here after opening it (new mode)

differences.description: Client-level rows here that differ from the firm server (kept as they are here)

SyncImport.description: What opening a pulled period did. A merge also carries upstream mergePeriod's result fields.

category.description: one of the engine's M-1 categories
